sources.entry: ghostty-designer - Live-preview editor for Ghostty themes, fonts and UI settings. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/reemus-dev/ghostty-designer) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: A GUI editor for Ghostty terminal themes, colours, fonts, cursor and window settings that previews every change live in running Ghostty windows before saving.
summary.what_it_does: The designer runs as a panel window launched from the terminal with the ghostty-designer command. Changes are written to a separate preview file that Ghostty includes and reloads, so the config file is untouched until you review a diff and save. It offers theme browsing with arrow-key trials, OKLCH colour sliders with contrast checks, a font browser with ligature, feature and variable-axis controls, and cursor, opacity, blur, padding, titlebar and split settings. Save rewrites only the changed keys in place, keeps comments and formatting, and makes backups first. It can also edit config files of other libghostty-based apps such as cmux, Supacode, Ghostex, agterm and macterm.
use_cases: Tweak Ghostty colours and themes visually
Preview terminal font and ligature changes live
Adjust Ghostty cursor, opacity and blur settings
Safely save config edits with a reviewed diff
Edit config of libghostty-based terminal apps
Browse and try Ghostty themes with arrow keys
how_to_run: git clone <repo URL> && cd ghostty-designer && mise install && mise run install && mise run build
notable: Live preview via an included ghostty-designer.conf file, so the real config is only changed on explicit save
Save review shows an exact diff and writes only changed lines, preserving comments and formatting
Automatic backups in original/ and previous/ folders with a Restore original option
Can edit configs of other libghostty apps such as cmux and Supacode
caveats: Requires Ghostty 1.3.1 or later to be installed; macOS 15 or later, or glibc 2.34 or later on Linux
On Linux, npm, Mise and tarball installs need WebKitGTK and GTK runtime libraries
Built entirely by AI agents in Claude Code per the README; an unofficial community tool not affiliated with Ghostty
Some settings apply only to new windows, and a cursor change may not show in unfocused windows
